rationale: C03 plausibly supplied the direct drafting template. It uses nearly identical language, the same six tax-return categories, the same 1945–1950 period, the same Senate committee and authorized subcommittee, the same economy-and-efficiency study rationale, the same Treasury-decision condition, and the same Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child principally updates the congressional session and broadens the inspection authorization by removing C03's tanker-sale limitation. C15 and C04 employ the same general tax-inspection machinery but concern different committees and purposes, making them weaker templates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1950 inclusive
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1950, inclusive
shared_material.explanation: The covered return categories and precise year range are virtually identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall, during the second session of the Eighty-second Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Expenditures in the Executive Departments or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall, during the first session of the Eighty-second Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Expenditures in the Executive Departments or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The operative authorization is copied almost verbatim, with only the congressional session updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: as a part of the study of the operation of Government activities with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.explanation: The same committee-study purpose is retained while C03's narrower tanker-sale investigation is omitted.
